name: Meta Tag Generator
description: Generate HTML meta tags for SEO, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, and Google Search Central-compliant snippets — copy-paste ready for U.S. websites.
longDescription: Meta Tag Generator creates complete meta tag sets for any webpage. Fill in your content details and get optimized tags for SEO (title, description, keywords), Open Graph (Facebook, LinkedIn), Twitter Cards, and additional tags like canonical, viewport, robots. All recommendations follow Google Search Central snippet and meta tag guidelines (https://developers.google.com/search/docs) and the Open Graph Protocol for accurate U.S. search and social previews. Preview how your links will appear on social platforms. Export as HTML or JSON.
pricingDetails: Completely free — $0 cost versus $12–$29/month SEO tool subscriptions. No account required.
features: SEO meta tags following Google Search Central snippet guidelines
Open Graph tags for accurate U.S. social media previews
Twitter Card tags with image, title, and description support
Social preview simulation for Facebook, LinkedIn, and X
Canonical URL, viewport, and robots tag support
HTML and JSON export for immediate deployment
useCases: U.S. website SEO optimization with standard-compliant meta tags
Social sharing optimization for American audiences
Blog post meta tags and landing page setup
Client project handoff with verified Google Search Central tags
